title: Erdős–Gyárfás Conjecture
next_action: PRIMARY (G016): EXTEND L061 BELOW delta>=4 TOWARD ALL PLANAR GRAPHS WITH delta>=3. S032 proved L061 -- every planar graph with delta>=4 contains a cycle of length 4 or 8 (also projective-planar; 2-connected toroidal/Klein) -- via L060 (in a C4-free graph a 5-cycle with three edges in triangles forces a C8; verified exhaustively to order 11) and discharging (mu(v)=d(v)-4, mu(f)=l(f)-4, triangles fed 1/3 per edge, pentagons blocked by L060) giving m <= 2n - 2*chi(S), which collides with m >= 2n from delta>=4 on an endblock. This is the dossier's FIRST result about statement 0.1 itself rather than about a reduction, and prior art was swept in both the Erdos-Gyarfas and planar-Turan literatures and NOT FOUND. The move: close the gap between L061 (delta>=4) and Heckman-Krakovski (3-connected CUBIC planar, conclusion '2^m for 2<=m<=7', NOT '4 or 8'). Four steps, each separately publishable if it lands: (A) reduce to 2-connected -- and note the STANDARD ARGUMENT IS INVALID HERE, because suppressing a degree-2 cut vertex shifts cycle lengths through it by 1 and the powers of two are not shift-invariant; what is available is minimality plus 'if deg_B(c)>=3 for an endblock B then B is a smaller counterexample', whose surviving case is deg_B(c)=2, deg_G(c)=4, all four neighbours cubic; (B) handle 2-cuts by the sumset S_1+S_2 of the two pieces' terminal path-length sets, using BOTH available augmentations (add the edge xy, shift +1; add a new vertex adjacent to x,y, shift +2 -- they shift differently and that is the leverage); (C) rule out degree->=4 vertices on planar graphs using the S032 count 'planar 2-connected {C4,C8}-free with delta>=3 has at least 10 + sum_{d>=5}(d-4) cubic vertices' plus the tight cubic-planar face identity sum_f (6 - l(f)) = 12 with no 4-faces and no 8-faces; (D) finish by citing Heckman-Krakovski. DO NOT REOPEN: the (F) programme, case (5b), or any through-set/ear/theta/exchange/interference argument as a route to 0.1 -- L059 proves the entire subdivision-covariant genre cannot reach 0.1, because subdividing every edge into a path of 3 multiplies all cycle lengths by 3 and 3 does not divide any power of 2 (smallest defeater K_4^(3), 16 vertices, L={9,12}, power-free, satisfying every recorded closure law).
